name: Exp_CGOscillator_X2
summary: This EA trades based on the CG Oscillator (Center of Gravity Oscillator) signals, entering buy positions when the oscillator crosses below a lower threshold and sell positions when it crosses above an upper threshold. It uses a dual-signal X2 confirmation approach with two CG Oscillator instances of different periods to filter false entries. The EA implements position management with fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CG振荡器（重心振荡器）信号进行交易，当振荡器向下穿越下阈值时开多仓，向上穿越上阈值时开空仓。它采用双信号X2确认方法，使用两个不同周期的CG振荡器实例来过滤虚假入场信号。EA实现了固定手数的仓位管理以及止损/止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于重心振荡器（CG Oscillator），该指标通过线性回归加权方法计算价格的重心位置，属于均值回归类策略。入场条件为：当快速CG振荡器和慢速CG振荡器同时发出超卖信号并反转时做多，当两者同时发出超买信号并反转时做空，X2双确认机制有效减少了单指标假信号。出场条件包括止损、止盈触发，以及反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面，止损和止盈由用户设定参数控制，但缺乏浮亏比例限制和最大持仓数量控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Center of Gravity (CG) Oscillator, which calculates the price's center of gravity through linear regression weighting, classifying it as a mean reversion strategy. Entry conditions require both a fast CG oscillator and a slow CG oscillator to simultaneously issue oversold signals and reverse for buy entries, and overbought signals and reverse for sell entries, with the X2 dual-confirmation mechanism effectively reducing false signals from a single indicator. Exit conditions include stop-loss and take-profit triggers, as well as position closing when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. In terms of money management, stop-loss and take-profit are controlled by user-set parameters, but there is no floating loss percentage limit or maximum position count control.

parameters.name: TakeProfit

parameters.name: TrailingStop

pros: 双CG振荡器X2确认机制有效过滤假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰，基于均值回归原理具有统计学依据
支持止损止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Dual CG Oscillator X2 confirmation mechanism effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
Clear strategy logic based on mean reversion principles with statistical justification
Supports stop-loss and take-profit settings, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 固定手数交易不考虑账户规模变化，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏最大持仓限制和浮亏比例控制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续止损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account size changes, making money management inflexible
Lacks maximum position limits and floating loss percentage controls, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled in extreme markets
Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive stop-losses in strong trending markets, lacking a trend filter mechanism
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率自动调整手数
添加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或长期均线），在强趋势行情中暂停或调整均值回归交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and volatility
Add a trend filter indicator (such as ADX or long-term moving average) to pause or adjust mean reversion trades during strong trending markets

risk_points: 固定手数在账户缩水时不能自动减少仓位，可能导致过度风险暴露
均值回归策略在单边趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot automatically reduce position size when the account shrinks, potentially leading to excessive risk exposure
Mean reversion strategy may produce consecutive losses during one-directional trending markets
